The Greek word for "communion" after "&" in section 6 is read as κοινωνοὶ from the scan; it is not certain. The line "Hoc enim vel maxime..." is italic on the scan; "inquit," appears roman. Printed "Ioh." and "Iovinianum" are rendered with J as consonant per the rules; the printed form is "Ioh." / "Iovinianum". No notes in the margins.
